column1: # Classification of every patch in Glide's src/ tree, by the upstream Firefox
# file it targets. Groups listed in glide-excluded-groups.txt are skipped when
# Regenerate the target list after a Glide sync with:
#     grep -m1 '^diff --git' "$p" | sed 's|^diff --git a/||; s| b/.*||'; done | sort
# vendor-branches.sh fails if a patch target is missing from this file, so a
# new upstream patch cannot silently slip into the build unclassified.
# firefox.js is rewritten by tools/ffprefs before surfer applies patches, so a
# patch against the pristine file can never match. `#include glide.js` is
# emitted by ffprefs::prepare_zen_prefs instead. Zen excludes this same file
# from scripts/recalculate-patches.sh for exactly the same reason.
